findings.proposed: UN R158 (reversing motor vehicles) only; drop R159

notes: Kmvss article records are accurate to their bodies; the short ones flagged by precheck as body-thin are genuinely whole one-paragraph articles (not stubs). Systemic issues: AI un_equivalent_ai picks the wrong R number on several records (R79, R157, R21, R125, R159), and the four kr-workbook-reg-059x records have template boilerplate instead of regulation text, with 0599 mislabelled body/tags copied from a REESS/fuel-safety template. Vehicle_categories often under-tagged for generic all-vehicle articles (Art 4, 34). Summaries are truncated with '...' mid-sentence in the frontmatter. External facts (UN R numbers) verified by web search; Korean statute article numbering within bodies was not independently verifiable (government sites blocked).
